info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Salesforce Analytics REST Change Events API
Salesforce Sales Cloud Describe a change event object

params.name: changeEventName
params.description: The change event API name (e.g., AccountChangeEvent for Account, Contact__ChangeEvent for a custom object)

items.docs: Retrieves metadata about a change event object. For standard objects, the change event name follows the pattern {ObjectName}ChangeEvent (e.g., AccountChangeEvent). For custom objects, the pattern is {ObjectName}__ChangeEvent.

info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Get full change event metadata

params.name: changeEventName
params.description: The change event API name (e.g., AccountChangeEvent for Account, Contact__ChangeEvent for a custom object)

items.docs: Returns complete metadata for a change event type including all header and changed fields. The change event header contains the changeType (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, UNDELETE), changedFields, commitTimestamp, transactionKey, and other metadata.
